title: 私有HOME启动配置综合项目：真实profile优先级、变量继承与失败回退
answer: 用真实login/interactive/noninteractive启动矩阵证明文件读取差异；profile显式source bashrc后仍须核对系统/用户赋值顺序。Shell局部x和导出APP_SCOPE分别在父Shell与子Python测量，不能混淆。私有baseline/candidate先语法和原生语义批准，切换后按字面active HOME复验，任何异常恢复旧配置并确认可用。
review_note: 原非程序题私有HOME改编，无原执行历史造假；不改真实用户/系统配置。
original_title: 您在 /etc/bashrc 中定义 x=2 和 x=6 ~/.bashrc 然后登录系统。 x 的值是多少？
body:
## 操作任务
完成私有HOME启动配置交付项目，回答“系统层x=2、用户层x=6，登录后一定是6吗”。不是对两行赋值下结论：必须以真实Bash读取启动文件、首个可读profile优先级、是否显式source bashrc及子进程继承证据验收。

本题固定测试私有fixture/system.bashrc（x=2）代表受控系统层样例，它不是实际/etc/bashrc；真实/etc/profile可能仍由Bash按系统策略读取，但不改任何/etc文件、真实账号HOME、默认Shell/环境或用户配置。环境为当前普通用户Linux/Bash，可读取真实启动文件但只在练习state及probe临时目录写入。原题是非程序题，本项目不伪造原题的故障执行历史。

四产物：profile.bash部署为候选HOME/.bash_profile，interactive.bash部署为候选HOME/.bashrc；probe_home.py真实采集启动矩阵；manage_home.py负责私有版本准备/阶段批准/原子切换/失败恢复。固定fixture有.bash_profile/.bashrc/.bash_login/.profile/system.bashrc/noninteractive.env六个普通文件，后四个不可修改，候选仅替换前两个。x是普通Shell变量，不能export；APP_SCOPE是导出变量，子Python必须实际继承它。profile.bash应记录profile标记、export LOGIN_FLAG=yes、显式source本HOME/.bashrc；interactive.bash先source本HOME/system.bashrc再x=6、export APP_SCOPE=user、记录user标记。标记使用OPSFORGE_TRACE指定的私有文件，每项独占一行，不污染stdout；可用语义等价的合法Shell写法。

## 多阶段交付
python3 manage_home.py prepare --state NEW --fixture FIXTURE：NEW已存在任何文件/目录/符号链接则拒绝，不覆盖，也不能先resolve后绕过dangling symlink身份。新建私有versions/baseline与evidence，把给定fixture原样复制为baseline并用原生probe确认x=4/APP_SCOPE=baseline，再记录baseline.json文件摘要、active相对symlink指向versions/baseline与独立prepare证据。初始化/验证失败清理本次新建state，包括限制umask导致的权限路径。

python3 manage_home.py stage --state STATE：只允许一份candidate，复制完整baseline，仅替换两个学员脚本。逐文件真实bash -n，再真实运行完整probe验证候选x=6/APP_SCOPE=user。全部通过才将独立暂存目录改名versions/candidate、记录candidate.json六文件SHA256与stage证据；失败清理暂存、不改变active或baseline。任何未知/缺失/符号链接启动文件均不允许进入批准版本。已批准candidate在activate前即使只增一条无害注释也须因身份改变拒绝，而非悄悄重签。

python3 manage_home.py activate --state STATE：核对candidate身份和语义，再原子替换仅本state的active相对symlink。必须以字面HOME=STATE/active再次执行真实启动探测（不能预先resolve成candidate来掩盖依赖HOME路径的错误）。切换后值错误、stdout破坏测量JSON、探针异常均恢复旧baseline链接，并实际确认旧HOME仍可运行，保留独立恢复证据，非零说明失败。正常重复activate可重新确认相同候选；python3 manage_home.py rollback --state STATE校验baseline身份、恢复baseline并实际probe确认；重复rollback保持旧语义。仅练习两代baseline/candidate，不宣称生产Shell配置发布系统。

所有state目录0700、配置/摘要/证据文件0600；继承umask0777仍可完成，各本进程临时umask finally恢复。probe只写自己新建的临时目录，不能改被测HOME或真实配置；evidence各阶段唯一文件，旧证据不覆盖。候选失败不删除baseline或旧证据。版本/切换只作用本练习HOME；没有部署、构建或默认身份变更。

## 原生矩阵及独立产物
python3 probe_home.py --home HOME --output NEW：NEW不存在时原子发布schema=1、home、六文件config_sha256和modes，不覆盖旧输出。modes恰为login、interactive_login、interactive、plain、envrc、bash_login、profile、bare。输入HOME的六文件均为可读普通文件；采集器应如实反映给定HOME，不能硬编码fixture的4/3/8，管理器的固定发布策略与通用原生采集器分离。必须记录真实x/scope/login_flag、Bash $-中的interactive、shopt login_shell、子Python环境child_x/child_scope、真实uid/home、trace、exit_status。stdout只输出measured=true/modes=8摘要，不将计划当结果。

login和interactive_login首选.bash_profile，应依次profile→global→user，x6、scope=user、LOGIN_FLAG=yes；interactive非login只读.bashrc，global→user，x6/scope=user且LOGIN_FLAG unset；plain非交互无BASH_ENV时无用户启动文件，x/scope/flag unset。envrc显式BASH_ENV=本HOME/noninteractive.env，x8/scope=envrc/trace envrc；这是真实显式BASH_ENV启动机制，不是安全隔离题。另在独立克隆HOME删除首选profile：只缺.bash_profile时读取.bash_login（x4/login-fallback/trace bash_login），再缺.bash_login时读取.profile（x3/profile-fallback/trace profile_fallback），三者全缺则不自动读.bashrc、x/scope unset。不能串行source所有profile伪造“优先级”。所有有scope的模式child_scope应相同；所有模式child_x均null，不能把Shell局部变量当成导出环境。baseline矩阵的主路径相应为x4/scope=baseline/trace最后baseline，fallback规则不变。

## 产物
profile.bash、interactive.bash、probe_home.py、manage_home.py；实际私有版本目录、active、摘要/阶段证据与八模式原生采集。多个脚本和多份JSON本身不构成通过，必须真实source顺序、子进程环境、切换前后行为及失败恢复都闭合。

## 环境与验收方法
非root Linux、/bin/bash、Python3标准库和/proc。可信检查器另起真实Bash独立复核活动HOME，不只相信学员probe报告；覆盖严格umask、重复activate/rollback、旧state/探针输出不可覆盖、dangling symlink、prepare失败清理、语法/语义失败、批准后修改、仅live HOME暴露的值错和探针异常、fallback优先级与Shell/子进程环境差别。四路线和至少三独立错误实现。只验证此受控fixture与当前系统Bash启动路径，不外推所有发行版/etc/bashrc调用策略或全账号隔离。
rubric: 核心概念与因果关系准确
前提、限制和验证方式与题意一致

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib
import json
import os
import secrets
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import shutil
import signal
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

ROOT=Path.cwd()
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
ARTIFACTS=('profile.bash','interactive.bash','probe_home.py','manage_home.py')
FIXTURE={
 '.bash_profile':'builtin printf "%s\\n" profile >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"\nexport LOGIN_FLAG=yes\n. "$HOME/.bashrc"\n',
 '.bashrc':'. "$HOME/system.bashrc"\nx=4\nexport APP_SCOPE=baseline\nbuiltin printf "%s\\n" baseline >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"\n',
 '.bash_login':'x=4\nexport APP_SCOPE=login-fallback\nbuiltin printf "%s\\n" bash_login >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"\n',
 '.profile':'x=3\nexport APP_SCOPE=profile-fallback\nbuiltin printf "%s\\n" profile_fallback >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"\n',
 'system.bashrc':'x=2\nbuiltin printf "%s\\n" global >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"\n',
 'noninteractive.env':'x=8\nexport APP_SCOPE=envrc\nbuiltin printf "%s\\n" envrc >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"\n',
}


def tree(root):return {str(path.relative_to(root)):path.read_bytes() for path in root.rglob('*') if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()}


def native(home,mode,trace):
    serializer="import json,os,sys;print(json.dumps({'x':sys.argv[1],'scope':sys.argv[2],'login_flag':sys.argv[3],'interactive':'i' in sys.argv[4],'login_shell':sys.argv[5]=='1','child_x':os.getenv('x'),'child_scope':os.getenv('APP_SCOPE'),'home':os.getenv('HOME'),'uid':os.geteuid()}))"
    script='if shopt -q login_shell;then login=1;else login=0;fi\n'+shlex.quote(sys.executable)+' -c '+shlex.quote(serializer)+' "${x-unset}" "${APP_SCOPE-unset}" "${LOGIN_FLAG-unset}" "$-" "$login"'
    environment={'HOME':str(home),'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LANG':'C.UTF-8','TERM':'dumb','HISTFILE':'/dev/null','OPSFORGE_TRACE':str(trace),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
    flags={'login':['--login','-c'],'interactive_login':['--login','-i','-c'],'interactive':['-i','-c'],'plain':['-c'],'envrc':['-c']}[mode]
    if mode=='envrc':environment['BASH_ENV']=str(home/'noninteractive.env')
    result=subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*flags,script],cwd=home,env=environment,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
    assert result.returncode==0,(mode,result.stdout,result.stderr)
    row=json.loads(result.stdout);row['trace']=trace.read_text().splitlines() if trace.exists() else []
    return row


def check_live(home,value,scope,label,directory):
    for mode in ('login','interactive_login','interactive','plain','envrc'):
        trace=directory/(str(time.monotonic_ns())+'.trace');row=native(home,mode,trace)
        if mode in ('login','interactive_login'):expected=(str(value),scope,'yes',['profile','global',label])
        elif mode=='interactive':expected=(str(value),scope,'unset',['global',label])
        elif mode=='plain':expected=('unset','unset','unset',[])
        else:expected=('8','envrc','unset',['envrc'])
        assert (row['x'],row['scope'],row['login_flag'],row['trace'])==expected,(mode,row)
        assert row['home']==str(home) and row['uid']==os.geteuid() and row['child_x'] is None
        assert row['child_scope']==(None if row['scope']=='unset' else row['scope'])
        assert row['interactive'] is (mode in ('interactive','interactive_login')) and row['login_shell'] is (mode in ('login','interactive_login'))


def materialize(root,patches=None):
    root.mkdir()
    for name in ARTIFACTS:(root/name).write_bytes((ROOT/name).read_bytes())
    for name,source in (patches or {}).items():(root/name).write_text(source)
    return root


def invoke(project,phase,state,fixture,expected=0,umask=-1):
    command=[sys.executable,str(project/'manage_home.py'),phase,'--state',str(state)]
    if phase=='prepare':command+=['--fixture',str(fixture)]
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15,umask=umask)
    if expected==0:assert result.returncode==0 and not result.stderr,(phase,result.returncode,result.stdout,result.stderr)
    else:assert result.returncode!=0 and result.stderr,(phase,result.returncode,result.stdout,result.stderr)
    return result


with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='startup-home-project-') as temporary:
    directory=Path(temporary);fixture=directory/'fixture';fixture.mkdir()
    for name,source in FIXTURE.items():(fixture/name).write_text(source);(fixture/name).chmod(0o600)
    original=tree(fixture)
    protected=[Path('/etc/profile'),Path('/etc/bash.bashrc'),Path.home()/'.bash_profile',Path.home()/'.bashrc',Path.home()/'.profile']
    protected={str(path):path.read_bytes() for path in protected if path.exists() and path.is_file()}
    project=materialize(directory/'project path ; literal');state=directory/'private state ; literal'
    print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:startup:prepare-stage-activate-rollback',flush=True)
    invoke(project,'prepare',state,fixture,umask=0o777)
    baseline=tree(state/'versions/baseline');check_live(state/'active',4,'baseline','baseline',directory)
    invoke(project,'stage',state,fixture,umask=0o777)
    assert os.readlink(state/'active')=='versions/baseline' and tree(state/'versions/baseline')==baseline
    invoke(project,'activate',state,fixture,umask=0o777);check_live(state/'active',6,'user','user',directory)
    invoke(project,'activate',state,fixture);check_live(state/'active',6,'user','user',directory)
    invoke(project,'rollback',state,fixture);check_live(state/'active',4,'baseline','baseline',directory)
    invoke(project,'rollback',state,fixture)
    for path in state.rglob('*'):
        if not path.is_symlink():assert not stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)&0o077,'state/config/evidence is not private'
    before=tree(state);invoke(project,'prepare',state,fixture,expected=2)
    assert tree(state)==before and tree(state/'versions/baseline')==baseline,'existing state changed'
    dangling=directory/'dangling-state';dangling.symlink_to(directory/'new-unwanted-target')
    invoke(project,'prepare',dangling,fixture,expected=2)
    assert dangling.is_symlink() and not (directory/'new-unwanted-target').exists()
    empty=directory/'empty-fixture';empty.mkdir();failed=directory/'failed-prepare'
    invoke(project,'prepare',failed,empty,expected=2,umask=0o777);assert not failed.exists(),'prepare initialization was not cleaned'
    # Student probe is compared to independently observed real Bash behavior,
    # including first-readable login precedence rather than sourcing every file.
    output=directory/'measured.json';result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(project/'probe_home.py'),'--home',str(state/'active'),'--output',str(output)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12,umask=0o777)
    assert result.returncode==0 and not result.stderr,(result.stdout,result.stderr)
    report=json.loads(output.read_text());assert type(report['schema']) is int and report['schema']==1
    assert set(report['modes'])=={'login','interactive_login','interactive','plain','envrc','bash_login','profile','bare'}
    for mode,expected in [('bash_login',('4','login-fallback',['bash_login'])),('profile',('3','profile-fallback',['profile_fallback'])),('bare',('unset','unset',[]))]:
        row=report['modes'][mode];assert (row['x'],row['scope'],row['trace'])==expected and row['login_shell'] is True and row['interactive'] is False
    assert report['modes']['login']['x']=='4' and report['modes']['plain']['x']=='unset'
    # The collector measures input HOME, while the manager validates the fixed
    # release policy. Random fallback/envrc values plus native Bash canaries
    # prevent a collector from merely printing the published fixture constants.
    counter=directory/'counterfactual-home';shutil.copytree(state/'versions/baseline',counter)
    canary=directory/'native-fallback-canary';expected_counter={}
    for mode,filename in [('bash_login','.bash_login'),('profile','.profile'),('envrc','noninteractive.env')]:
        value=str(20+secrets.randbelow(70));scope=mode+'-'+secrets.token_hex(5);label='native-'+scope
        source='x='+value+'\nexport APP_SCOPE='+scope+'\nbuiltin printf "%s\\n" '+shlex.quote(label)+' >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"\n'
        source+='builtin printf "%s:%s:%s\\n" '+shlex.quote(mode)+' "$BASHPID" "$BASH_VERSION" >> '+shlex.quote(str(canary))+'\n'
        (counter/filename).write_text(source);expected_counter[mode]=(value,scope,[label])
    alternate_output=directory/'counterfactual-probe.json'
    result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(project/'probe_home.py'),'--home',str(counter),'--output',str(alternate_output)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
    assert result.returncode==0,(result.stdout,result.stderr)
    alternate_report=json.loads(alternate_output.read_text())
    for mode,expected in expected_counter.items():
        row=alternate_report['modes'][mode];assert (row['x'],row['scope'],row['trace'])==expected,(mode,row,expected)
    observed=[line.split(':',2) for line in canary.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(observed)==3 and {row[0] for row in observed}==set(expected_counter)
    assert all(row[1].isdigit() and row[2] for row in observed),'native Bash fallback execution canary missing'
    saved=output.read_bytes();result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(project/'probe_home.py'),'--home',str(state/'active'),'--output',str(output)],capture_output=True,timeout=12)
    assert result.returncode!=0 and output.read_bytes()==saved,'probe overwrote existing result'
    for name,patches in [('syntax',{'profile.bash':'if then\n'}),
                         ('semantic',{'interactive.bash':'. "$HOME/system.bashrc"\nx=2\nexport APP_SCOPE=user\nbuiltin printf "%s\\n" user >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"\n'})]:
        alternate=materialize(directory/('project-'+name),patches);target=directory/('state-'+name)
        invoke(alternate,'prepare',target,fixture);old=tree(target/'versions/baseline')
        invoke(alternate,'stage',target,fixture,expected=2)
        assert os.readlink(target/'active')=='versions/baseline' and tree(target/'versions/baseline')==old
        assert not (target/'versions/candidate').exists() and not list((target/'versions').glob('.candidate-*'))
        check_live(target/'active',4,'baseline','baseline',directory)
    # Repeated activation can fail from an external runtime condition without
    # altering any approved startup bytes. Recover baseline, not previous==candidate.
    reference_profile=(ROOT/'profile.bash').read_text()
    target=directory/'state-repeat-failure';flag=target/'inject-failure'
    suffix='if [[ $HOME == */active && -e '+shlex.quote(str(flag))+' ]];then x=99;fi\n'
    alternate=materialize(directory/'project-repeat-failure',{'profile.bash':reference_profile+suffix})
    invoke(alternate,'prepare',target,fixture);old=tree(target/'versions/baseline');invoke(alternate,'stage',target,fixture)
    approved=tree(target/'versions/candidate');invoke(alternate,'activate',target,fixture)
    check_live(target/'active',6,'user','user',directory);flag.write_text('fault now enabled\n')
    invoke(alternate,'activate',target,fixture,expected=2)
    assert os.readlink(target/'active')=='versions/baseline' and tree(target/'versions/baseline')==old
    assert tree(target/'versions/candidate')==approved,'runtime condition test modified approved candidate'
    check_live(target/'active',4,'baseline','baseline',directory)
    # Stage artifacts are immutable: even a harmless comment must not be silently
    # activated after approval, because the exact staged identity changed.
    altered=materialize(directory/'project-tamper');target=directory/'state-tamper'
    invoke(altered,'prepare',target,fixture);invoke(altered,'stage',target,fixture)
    with (target/'versions/candidate/.bashrc').open('a') as stream:stream.write('# changed after approval\n')
    invoke(altered,'activate',target,fixture,expected=2);assert os.readlink(target/'active')=='versions/baseline'
    # Only the live lexical HOME ends in /active. These candidates pass syntax
    # and staged probes but fail real post-switch behavior or JSON measurement.
    for name,suffix in [('live-value','if [[ $HOME == */active ]];then x=99;fi\n'),
                        ('live-exception','if [[ $HOME == */active ]];then builtin printf invalid-json;fi\n')]:
        alternate=materialize(directory/('project-'+name),{'profile.bash':reference_profile+suffix});target=directory/('state-'+name)
        invoke(alternate,'prepare',target,fixture);invoke(alternate,'stage',target,fixture)
        invoke(alternate,'activate',target,fixture,expected=2)
        assert os.readlink(target/'active')=='versions/baseline','failed live startup did not restore old HOME'
        check_live(target/'active',4,'baseline','baseline',directory)
    assert tree(fixture)==original
    assert all(Path(path).read_bytes()==raw for path,raw in protected.items()),'real user/system startup configuration changed'
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
